items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required load names and labels; p20 left and p300 right with matching tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
The p300 aspirates 100 uL from reservoir A1 twice and dispenses 100 uL into plate A1 and then B1; the end_state check passed with [100, 100].
Each loop iteration calls pick_up_tip before aspirating and drop_tip at the end; the tip_before_aspirate and tip_dropped_at_end checks passed.
100 uL is within the p300 range, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the blow_out at the well top is safe; the simulation ran without error.
The code does the single transfer step as specified and the comments and metadata describe it accurately.

judge.summary: The protocol transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and B1 with the p300, using a fresh tip for each well. All measured checks passed and the rubric items are met.
